name: Shin'ya 0-ji ❤ Sugao no Shitsuji
source:
After being transferred, it's time for your sweet debut in Tokyo. However, the apartment you moved in includes its own butler!

In the mornings, he prepares breakfasts and serves tea.
In the evenings, he sets up your bed and helps you relax after a long day of working hard.

However, there's a secret behind his smiling face...

"You don't know how bad a butler can be".

Your life in a top new apartment with the ultimate butler has just begun!

[Source: [url=http://koi-game.voltage.co.jp/works/stji/index.html]Voltage[/url]]
translation:
转校之后，你将在东京开始甜蜜的新生活。然而，你搬进的公寓竟然自带管家！

早晨，他为你准备早餐、奉上红茶。
晚上，他铺好床铺，在你辛苦工作一天后帮助你放松。

可是，他的笑容背后隐藏着一个秘密……

“你根本不知道管家能坏到什么程度。”

与终极管家一起住进顶级新公寓的生活，就此开始！

[来源：[url=http://koi-game.voltage.co.jp/works/stji/index.html]Voltage[/url]]
